role: One independent initial substantive SCI gate by main; Huygens and Carson authored.

independentAssessment: Blocks0/1 retain all original everyday examples, but reject universal claims that every liquid action or rainbow depends solely on surface tension. Material, wetting and optical conditions remain explicit.
Blocks2/5 retain faucet detachment and an open straw-connected bubble. The elastic film is expressly an analogy, not a real solid skin; no claim that a sealed bubble necessarily shrinks.
Blocks6/7 retain needle, water-strider, sieve and woven-cloth examples with wetting, pressure, buoyancy and surface-force conditions. No unconditional support or impermeability claim.

Blocks8/9 distinguish gravity deformation, aerodynamic forces, solid contact and flow from the free fixed-volume droplet model. Small drops and quiet free microgravity liquid may approach spheres; not every raindrop or container-bound fluid.

Blocks10/11 retain attraction/flow/minimum-area explanations without molecular intent, a permanent inward force on every molecule or a literal fixed-site model. Constant conditions and no competing constraint delimit the spherical equilibrium.
Block12 distinguishes liquid tension per boundary length from total force and rubber elasticity; density is only approximately constant, not fixed at arbitrary temperature or pressure.
lessons.notation: Original figure67 math token retained; no new formula or numeric value.

independentAssessment: Blocks0/1 treat the source molecular potential-energy explanation as a simplified interface-versus-bulk picture, not a pointwise statement about every instantaneous molecular energy or all intermolecular distances.

Block2 explicitly distinguishes surface internal-energy contributions from excess surface free energy and reversible fixed-temperature surface work. Homogeneous gas lacking its own liquid free surface does not mean gas-related interfaces lack energy.
Block3 retains the pressure-work bubble and gravitational spreading examples, but separates other interface energies, wetting, dissipation and work contributions.

Blocks4/5/6 preserve original U,S,S,sigma token order and equation5-1. A uniform, equilibrium, fixed-temperature, fixed-media/composition, area-independent-coefficient model makes excess surface free energy per area equal to reversible surface work per area. It is not general internal energy divided by area.
Block7 correctly retains joules per square metre and its equivalent newtons per metre, with medium, temperature and composition dependence.
Block8 limits minimum-area spherical equilibrium to fixed volume, uniform coefficient and no competing force, container or interface constraint. Other equilibria require total energy and constraints.
Block9 limits the vanishing liquid-vapor tension to a pure-fluid coexistence path approaching its critical endpoint; at the endpoint the distinguishable interface itself disappears.
lessons.notation: Only descriptive text subscript localized to surface; raw n-shaped source glyph retained honestly without alphabet inference.
